nodes.description: Public address holding the sale contract owner; set in constructor and transferred via two-way handshake.
Pending owner address used for the two-step ownership handshake.
Arbitrary public notice string settable by the owner.
Sale start time, compared against block.timestamp in the payable fallback.
Sale end time, controlling whether the sale closes in the fallback.
Ether hard cap compared against this.balance in the fallback.
Boolean flag indicating whether the sale is currently live.
Constructor assigning owner = msg.sender.
Payable fallback that gates contributions on block.timestamp/start/end/cap and toggles live plus StartSale/EndSale events.
onlyOwner initializer writing start, end and cap.
onlyOwner function reducing or moving the sale end time, bounded by block.timestamp and start.
onlyOwner function setting the pending newOwner for the ownership handshake.
Completes ownership handshake when msg.sender equals newOwner.
onlyOwner function writing arbitrary text into notice.
onlyOwner function transferring the full contract balance to msg.sender.
onlyOwner function transferring a bounded amount of Ether to msg.sender.
onlyOwner function pulling an arbitrary ERC20 token balance of the contract to msg.sender.
onlyOwner function transferring an arbitrary ERC20 token amount to an arbitrary recipient.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, authorization checks and transfer recipients.
Miner-influenced timestamp used as the sale time gate and bound in softCap.
msg.sender.transfer(this.balance) performed before any state cleanup, external ETH call to an untrusted address.
msg.sender.transfer(value) external ETH call to an untrusted address.
External call Token(token).transfer(msg.sender, t.balanceOf(this)) to an attacker-supplied contract.
External call Token(token).transfer(sender, amount) to an attacker-supplied contract and recipient.
Parameter _start of init, written into start.
Parameter _end of init, written into end.
Parameter _cap of init, written into cap.
Parameter _newend of softCap, written into end after timestamp bounds.
Parameter next of changeOwner, written into newOwner.
Parameter note of setNotice, written into notice.
Parameter value of withdrawSome, bounded by this.balance before transfer.
Parameter token of withdrawToken, used to instantiate the Token interface.
Parameter token of refundToken, used to instantiate the Token interface.
Parameter sender of refundToken, used as the token transfer recipient.
Parameter amount of refundToken, used as the token transfer amount.
Local Token instance in withdrawToken wrapping the caller-supplied token address.
Local Token instance in refundToken wrapping the caller-supplied token address.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns owner from msg.sender, making the initial owner caller-controlled.
Fallback emits EtherIn(msg.sender, msg.value) using the untrusted caller address.
Fallback execution branch depends on block.timestamp versus start and end (timestamp dependency).
Fallback flips the live flag when the sale opens or closes.
Fallback reads start to require block.timestamp >= start.
Fallback reads end to decide whether to close the sale.
Fallback compares this.balance against cap to enforce the hard cap.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before init body executes.
Parameter _start is written into state variable start.
Parameter _end is written into state variable end.
Parameter _cap is written into state variable cap.
init writes start.
init writes end.
init writes cap.
onlyOwner modifier gates softCap on msg.sender == owner.
softCap requires _newend >= block.timestamp, tying sale configuration to the timestamp (timestamp dependency).
Parameter _newend is written into state variable end.
softCap overwrites end with the new end time.
onlyOwner modifier gates changeOwner on msg.sender == owner.
Parameter next is written into newOwner.
changeOwner sets the pending owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner, an authorization check on caller input.
acceptOwnership promotes msg.sender to owner.
acceptOwnership clears the pending newOwner.
onlyOwner modifier gates setNotice on msg.sender == owner.
Parameter note is written into the public notice string.
setNotice overwrites notice.
onlyOwner modifier gates withdraw on msg.sender == owner.
withdraw performs an external ETH transfer to msg.sender, allowing the recipient to re-enter the contract.
The ETH transfer sends the entire balance to the untrusted caller address, the classic reentrancy sink.
onlyOwner modifier gates withdrawSome on msg.sender == owner.
Parameter value is validated against this.balance inside withdrawSome.
withdrawSome calls transfer on the untrusted caller address, permitting re-entrant calls.
The value transfer is delivered to msg.sender, an attacker-controlled external receiver.
onlyOwner modifier gates withdrawToken on msg.sender == owner.
Parameter token is used to instantiate the local Token interface variable.
withdrawToken creates the local Token instance from the supplied address.
withdrawToken makes an external call into an arbitrary token contract supplied by the caller.
Local Token instance t is the receiver of the external transfer call.
msg.sender is used as the recipient of the token transfer in withdrawToken.
onlyOwner modifier gates refundToken on msg.sender == owner.
Parameter token is used to instantiate the local Token interface variable in refundToken.
refundToken creates the local Token instance from the supplied address.
refundToken makes an external call into an arbitrary token contract supplied by the caller.
Parameter sender is used as the recipient of the external token transfer.
Parameter amount is used as the value of the external token transfer.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _start exists only to initialize the start state variable inside init.
Parameter _end exists only to initialize the end state variable inside init.
Parameter _cap exists only to initialize the cap state variable inside init.
Parameter _newend is only consumed by softCap to rewrite the end time.
Parameter next is only consumed by changeOwner to set newOwner.
Parameter note is only consumed by setNotice to write the notice string.
Parameter value is only used as the transfer amount bound in withdrawSome.
Parameter token is only used to build the external call target in withdrawToken.
Parameter token is only used to build the external call target in refundToken.
Parameter sender flows directly into the external token transfer of refundToken.
Parameter amount flows directly into the external token transfer of refundToken.
Local Token instance t is merely the target of the external call in withdrawToken.
Local Token instance t is merely the target of the external call in refundToken.
